name: LaBeau's (Garden City, UT) Seedless Fresh Banana Cheesecake Milkshake Hack
whyItWorks: The ultimate seed-free shake hack at LaBeau's! Unlike their famous raspberry shake (which has thousands of tiny abrasive seeds), fresh banana is completely seed-free, soothing, and potassium-rich.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a small or regular Banana or Vanilla Cheesecake shake instead of the seeded raspberry shake.
watchOuts: Contains dairy lactose; take lactase enzyme tablet if lactose sensitive
